edits.before:
That clause is the course's position in one line. The class is mixed by
design: people who were never handed the protocol, and people who run it
fluently and can't describe it. Both kinds of reference get you in, and the
reference doesn't ask which kind you are.
edits.after:
Both kinds of reference count. You do not have to say whether the protocol
comes easily to you.
edits.reason: Keep the practical consequence of the entry rule without explaining the virtue of the sentence above it.

edits.before:
That's why the Field Journal has no word count. A fixed length is what makes
generated text convenient, and a journal entry that is fifty words of your own
is worth more than five hundred that aren't.
edits.after: The Field Journal has no word limit or minimum.
edits.reason: Keep the length policy without claiming that word counts explain AI misuse or turning the authorship rule into a slogan.
